name: proximo
description: Makes local Docker containers reachable at https://<name>.test with trusted HTTPS and local DNS, and shares a route with colleagues over the team's mesh. Use when bringing up a project's containers, exposing a container or giving a service a local hostname through proximo.* labels, or calling and testing a containerized service, and when diagnosing a broken one: a .test host that does not resolve or answer, a 502/503, an untrusted local certificate, a page that loads and then breaks, a request whose container output you need, a queue or worker that is not progressing, a container that cannot reach a VPN or tunnelled address the host reaches, or a shared link that fails.
